# I13 · Ghi nhận CSKH

Group **I · Vận hành Clinic · bổ sung từ web** · detail screen · status: **ported**

> Web › crm › Xử lý · kênh, kết quả, bước tiếp theo, phụ trách; không gửi tin/gọi thật

## Logic source
- Web: crm › Xử lý · kênh, kết quả, bước tiếp theo, phụ trách; không gửi tin/gọi thật
- Web-only: logic ported from `prototype/shared/*.js` into the `shared/clinic` domain (`ClinicStore`, `transact` commands, `ClinicError` errors keep the web's Vietnamese messages).
- Permissions follow `prototype/shared/staff-context.js` (`pages` + `capabilities`) → `Session.allows` + `session.staffContext().can(...)`.
- Web `crm-ui.js` "Xử lý" form; `ClinicStore.resolveCrmTask` / `prepareCrmBooking` (CashierCrmCommands).

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.CareRecord` ("care-record") · app bar "Ghi nhận CSKH"
- Composable: `CareRecordScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/care/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/care/CareRecordScreen.kt`
- Registered by graph: `careRecordGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `crmOutcomes`, `crmQueue`, `patient`, `prepareCrmBooking`, `resolveCrmTask`, `staffContext`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/care/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/care/CareRecordShotTest.kt:19` → `pema-kmp/feature/care/build/shots/I13-vs.png`
- Canvas image: `pema-kmp/design-ref/I13.png`

## Required canvas text (keep verbatim)
- Ghi nhận cuộc gọi/tin nhắn mô phỏng. Không gửi Zalo/SMS hoặc thực hiện cuộc gọi thật.

## Business rules
- Entry point: the "Vận hành phòng khám" item at the end of each role's main screen (filtered by permission).
- The outcome "Đồng ý đặt lịch" opens I4 with `crmTask` before completing.
- No real Zalo/SMS or calls.

## Accepted differences from the canvas
- Web seed data (DAY = 2026-09-20, P001 Nguyễn Minh Linh) instead of the canvas's illustrative names/dates.
